rss: AI boom helps drive surprise UK growth in July
title: Robot Craze Boosts BizKid Economy
story: Lots of people are super excited about robots! Because of this, more and more robot toys and games are being sold, helping the BizKid world grow by 0.4%.
storyBig: The rising interest in robotic technology has unexpectedly fueled economic growth by 0.4% in the BizKid world. This surge was driven by increased demand for robot-related products and experiences.
think: Why do you think robots are becoming so popular?
bull: More robots mean more fun and learning!
bear: Not everyone might want to buy a robot.

rss: Primark finally set to launch home deliveries
title: Toy Store Starts Home Deliveries
story: The famous toy store in BizKid Land is now delivering toys right to your door! This means kids can get their favorite toys without leaving home.
storyBig: After years of anticipation, a major toy retail company in BizKid Land has initiated a home delivery service. This move marks a significant shift towards greater convenience for customers.
think: How would getting toys delivered to your house change your shopping habits?
bull: Home delivery means getting toys faster and easier!
bear: Some might miss the fun of shopping in person.
